comment: hack.c still_chewing(): a debug Caveman level-teleports to Minetown (^V menu, which builds minetn-6 for this seed), drops everything, wishes 400 gold, polymorphs into a rock mole and teleports (^T) into Izchak's lighting store, then chews through its west wall: the in_rooms(SHOPBASE) branch (754-756) adds shop damage, and the keeper's 'Beast!' line comes from shk.c cad(). After paying, ^V 4 lands on a Mines filler level (is_cavernous_lev, not in town), where chewing a wall turns it into corridor (761).
